text:
Noah: Quick sync Planning a 30m livestream called the "Starter Cookbook" target: devs who want plug-and-play inference. Format: 8m build a tiny refapp, 7m perf knobs, 10m Q&A + 5m signposting assets. Need landing copy, gate, routing, and two email subject variants for A/B.
Ivy: Love the "cookbook" vibe. Keep repo as a 5-file cookbook: README, cook/01-setup, cook/02-infer, cook/03-speedups, bench/run.sh.
Carla: Lead capture rec: one dropdown (company_size: solo/startup/growth/enterprise) + role. Map enterprise -> AE queue. HubSpot listId=52345, hidden lead_source=starter_cookbook_2026, utm_campaign=starter_cookbook_live. Who will draft the field labels?
Ethan: I'll do the HS form and the automation. Suggest automation ladder: non-enterprise -> 3-email nurture (tips, benchmark, on-demand clip); enterprise -> immediate AE ping + add to "hot-dev-inbound" Slack channel. Also set tag starter_cookbook_2026 for all registrants.
Noah: Perf story: show baseline vs "cookbook-tuned" using small batching + prefix caching + int8 quant where safe. Metrics: p95 latency, $/1k tokens, tokens/sec. Keep the bench reproducible.
Ivy: Bench commands to include in cook/bench/README:
```bash
# baseline run
bash bench/run.sh --model=mini --batch=1 --quant=none --iters=120
# cookbook-tuned
bash bench/run.sh --model=mini --batch=8 --quant=int8 --kv_cache=on --iters=120
```
I'll annotate expected outputs and CSV path.
Carla: Email subject A/B ideas: (A) "Starter Cookbook: Build + Cut Inference Cost in 30m" (B) "Live: Build a refapp & speed up inference Join us". Which resonates?
Ethan: A is punchier. For send cadence: invite, 48h reminder, 1h reminder. Also two post-event drips: on-demand clip + benchmark CSV.
Noah: Landing page hero line: "Follow the Starter Cookbook and get inference running fast—no infra sweat." Keep short.
Ivy: Repo will include a tiny Dockerfile so attendees can run locally. Also add a CONTRIBUTING.md so community can submit new 'recipes'.
Carla: HubSpot mapping: fields -> email,name,role,company_size(dropdown),hidden:lead_source,utm_campaign. listId=52345. Automation: if company_size==enterprise -> owner=ae_rotation; else -> add to nurture_list. Also if attendee downloads CSV -> add tag engaged_bench.
Ethan: I'll wire the owner rotation and create a webhook to post AE pings to #sales-inbound with registrant info. Need ok to include attendee company name in the Slack ping? privacy check?
Noah: Ok to include company name and role. No PII beyond name & email. Keep GDPR note on the form.
Ivy: For social: short tweet, X thread, and a long LinkedIn post. Suggest copy: "Starter Cookbook: Live 30m demo + tiny benchmark. Build a refapp + see how small infra changes cut cost. Wed 11am PT. Register: https://tiny.redwood/cookbook".
Carla: Add UTM structure: utm_source=organic,utm_medium=social,utm_campaign=starter_cookbook_live. We'll append for each channel.
Ethan: Event routing: registrants -> tag starter_cookbook_2026. Attendees -> add to on-demand list and send clip + resources. Hot action: if they click "request enterprise consult" -> AE alert.
Noah: Quick iteration on email body: include one short code snippet CTA + link to repo. Example: 
```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
print(c.generate("summarize: 'short'"))
```
Small and copy-pasteable.
Ivy: We'll record and produce a 2-3min highlight clip and a 45s social cut. Post-event assets: clip, CSV, blog mini-post (bench narrative).
Carla: For bench narrative blurb: "Small infra shifts (batching, caching, quant) drove a 2-3x reduction in cost with comparable p95 latency for common prompt lengths." Keep conservative.
Ethan: I'll set up the tracking: HubSpot form publishes -> provide canonical reg URL. Also create a conversion goal in Analytics (event: reg_complete).
Noah: Anything on A/B testing the email subject? We'll run 50/50 and measure open rate and reg rate over 48h.
Carla: Yes. We'll sample the first 500 sends. Metric: registrations per 1k opens.
Ivy: Design request: hero (1200x600) and a 5s animated thumbnail for the highlight. @design can we get three variants (devy, product, enterprise) so we can A/B on social?
Ethan: Ops-bot: scheduled reminders will be 48h, 1h, and 10m.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Starter Cookbook livestream" Wed 11:00 PT reminders: 48h, 1h, 10m.
Noah: Final checklist: repo + Docker (Ivy), bench CSV + notebook (Ivy), HS form + automations (Ethan), social + email copy (Carla), design hero + thumb (design). Ping here when each is ready. :chef::rocket:
